body: AdrienBroner is going viral AGAIN after an encounter with one of his own fans that reportedly took a very awkward turn. The former world champion asked a fan for $1,000 just to take a picture with him. When the fan declined the request, Broner reportedly became upset and SPAZZED out on the very person who was simply hoping to get a photo with him. Does deenthegreat need to split and go solo?
